stages.name: 成層圏

stages.name: 静止軌道駅

stages.name: 帰路の夜明け
stages.prompt: poetic anime scene, Earth dawn terminator glowing blue and gold beyond a station window, slow drifting dust, quiet finale

character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: dark brown hair in a half-up style, soft rose-brown eyes, a composed expression and strong brows; a field-tested futuristic courier, wearing a sleek technical jacket with luminous piping, fitted utility trousers, and compact gear with carbon black accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in tower base on the equator, climber car in the clouds, upper station above the atmosphere; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with dawn gold, sky blue, carbon black, cable silver; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by long vertical tilt up the cable to the stars, wide ground shot of the tower's base, close-up of a climbing car; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
